'''Veneron''' was the [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[City/Legends|city]] of the [[Klatooinian/Legends|Klatooinian]] [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of [[Klatooine/Legends|Klatooine]] during the era of [[Darth Krayt's Galactic Empire]].<ref name="LECG" /> During the earlier [[Imperial Era/Legends|Imperial Period]], the [[Planet/Legends|planet's]] capital was [[Treema]].<ref name="LoNH">''[[Lords of Nal Hutta]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Veneron was mentioned in the ''[[Legacy Era Campaign Guide]]'', a roleplaying game sourcebook published by [[Wizards of the Coast]] in [[2009]].<ref name="LECG" />
